  <script>const money=n=>Number.isInteger(n)?n:n.toFixed(2);
const whatsapp=(name,detail,price)=>'https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=593991017792&text='+encodeURIComponent(`Hola TEAMFIT 🤍 Me interesa ${name.toLowerCase()}, ${detail}, de ${money(price)}. ¿Sigue disponible?`);
const host=document.getElementById('catalog');

products.forEach(p=>{
  const section=document.createElement('article'); section.className='product';
  const gallery=document.createElement('div'); gallery.className='gallery'; gallery.setAttribute('aria-label',`Fotos de ${p.name} ${p.ref}`);
  const info=document.createElement('div');
  info.innerHTML=`${p.stock?`<span class="stock">${p.stock}</span>`:''}<span class="ref">REF. ${p.ref}</span><h3>${p.name}</h3><p class="price">${money(p.price)}</p>${p.separate?`<p class="separate">${p.separate}</p>`:''}`;
  const variants=document.createElement('div'); variants.className='variants'; variants.setAttribute('aria-label','Colores disponibles');
  const order=document.createElement('a'); order.className='button'; order.target='_top'; order.rel='noopener'; order.textContent='Pedir por WhatsApp ↗';
  const render=v=>{
    gallery.replaceChildren(...v.images.map(src=>{const im=document.createElement('img');im.src=src;im.alt=`${p.name} ref. ${p.ref} · ${v.color}`;im.loading='lazy';return im}));
    gallery.scrollLeft=0; order.href=whatsapp(`${p.name} referencia ${p.ref}`,v.color,p.price);
    [...variants.children].forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.textContent===v.color)));
  };
  p.variants.forEach(v=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=v.color;b.onclick=()=>render(v);variants.append(b)});
  info.append(variants,order);
  const hint=document.createElement('p'); hint.className='hint'; hint.textContent='Desliza las fotos para ver los detalles. Consulta tu talla por WhatsApp.'; info.append(hint);
  section.append(gallery,info); host.append(section); render(p.variants[0]);
});

const saleHost=document.getElementById('sale-catalog');
saleProducts.forEach(p=>{
  const card=document.createElement('article'); card.className='sale-card';
  const gallery=document.createElement('div'); gallery.className='sale-gallery';
  gallery.replaceChildren(...p.images.map(src=>{const im=document.createElement('img');im.src=src;im.alt=`${p.name} ${p.color}`;im.loading='lazy';return im}));
  const info=document.createElement('div'); info.className='sale-info';
  info.innerHTML=`<span class="stock">${p.stock||'PRECIO ESPECIAL'}</span><h3>${p.name}</h3><p class="sale-color">${p.color}${p.size?` · ${p.size}`:''}</p><p class="sale-price">${p.originalPrice?`<del>${money(p.originalPrice)}</del>`:''}<strong>${money(p.price)}</strong></p>`;
  const order=document.createElement('a'); order.className='button'; order.target='_top'; order.rel='noopener'; order.textContent='Quiero esta prenda ↗'; order.href=whatsapp(p.name,`${p.color}${p.size?`, ${p.size}`:''}`,p.price);
  info.append(order); card.append(gallery,info); saleHost.append(card);
});

const saleSection=document.getElementById('sale');
document.querySelector('.sale-pill').addEventListener('click',()=>{saleSection.open=true});
</script>
</body>
</html>
